items.title: AI infrastructure stocks surge after strong earnings from CoreWeave, Supermicro
items.summary: AI infrastructure stocks jumped, with shares of AI server makers, optical-products companies, and neocloud providers moving higher.

items.title: Lumentum Still Down Over 90 Days: A Respected Analyst Sees 22% Gains Ahead Following Sharp Upturn

items.summary: Coherent Corp. (NYSE:COHR) delivered stronger-than-expected fourth-quarter results and issued an ambitious outlook for fiscal 2027, supported by robust customer demand and expanding production capacity.

items.title: COHR Stock Dips Overnight Despite Strong Q4: Retail Bulls Keep The Faith

items.title: Lumentum and AXT Ripped Higher. Investors Looking for Broad Optics Exposure Should Consider This Brand-New ETF
items.summary: Lumentum's blowout quarter sent shockwaves through the entire optical supply chain, and now a brand-new ETF is betting the AI connectivity trade is just getting started. The question is whether that concentrated wager can hold up when hyperscaler capex turns.
